Keep frozen Bun installation and all pinned tools; validate the partial-cache path with a real source-invalidation run.

Changing check-task-costs.json from one measured duration to another invalidated tooling source hashes and downstream check verdicts, although the checks themselves never read those observations. Exclude duration telemetry from source, type-check and test inputs; preserve JSON formatting validation in lint and always read current costs in the uncached planner.

The environment declaration health step buffered synchronous infrastructure children without deadlines, hiding the active operation until its 900000ms scenario timeout. Bounded credential reads, tool diagnostics and asynchronously supervised read-only stack groups fail closed with the blocked operation named.

Live health loaded UI-dependent steps before installing the Solid/macro loader, so a fresh Depot checkout failed resolving babel-plugin-macros instead of running its health scenarios. The health CLI now explicitly preloads the shared browser test runtime before generated stubs.

OpenTofu plan diagnostics printed configured report and broker access identifiers into local deployment logs. Tool and plan diagnostics now redact configured credential values and credential fields while policy evaluation still receives the complete plan.

The pre-commit spec ownership gate rejected a resolved merge from main because already committed account deletion specs appeared beside implementation changes in the index. Audit only specs changed against both merge parents; inherited specs retain their original commits and newly authored mixed resolutions remain refused.

Development deploy health loaded the local DOM harness when linking live steps, failing every feature with missing babel-plugin-macros; forcing browser conditions also broke the S3 server adapter. Give live health its own step entry so it runs deployed resource adapters with Bun’s server runtime, while local spec suites retain their Solid preloads.

A client was reported fetching obsolete dev-api.gamezilla.app after the dev environment moved to api-dev.gamezilla.app. Keep deployed API and broker endpoint bindings owned by the environment file, so copied secret or Worker settings cannot override the canonical endpoints; the client build and bundle guard already use hosts.api.
A board sound requested while disabled could play after re-enabling if its seek had not completed. Guard both request and playback against parent sound authority.
A retained sound handle could start playback after its board scope was disposed. Disposed handles remain inert.
Hiding a page did not cancel already-running piece motion or a capture remnant, allowing old transitions to resume when shown. Hidden motion settles immediately.
Switching away during a held pointer gesture left its avatar and pointer session alive. Activity focus loss cancels and releases the gesture without a move.

At 319.5 CSS pixels and half scale, grid track rounding and a rotated hit grid displaced piece centers from their square centers in White and Black orientations. Place all hit targets with the same fractional cell transforms as pieces.
A requested animation duration of NaN or Infinity left motion enabled without a finite completion, potentially keeping capture remnants indefinitely. Invalid durations settle immediately.
Closing the first board while shared audio warmup awaited a seek could pause the same sound already playing for a second board. Warmup may only pause unowned players.
A checkmated or stalemated board allowed a piece to be selected or held despite offering no further move. Finished games refuse piece input.
A stalemating move played end feedback but its live announcement omitted stalemate, leaving silent users without the result. Announce the stalemate alongside the move.

After an optimistic White e2-e4, the parent supplied the canonical Black e7-e5 successor without an intermediate confirmation. The board incorrectly treated it as desync repair and suppressed its highlight and sound. Canonical successors retain move feedback.
A genuinely traveled drag returned to e2 or dropped outside reselected the source as if it were a tap. Abandoned drags clear selection; stationary presses retain tap semantics.
Replacing the mating queen g6-g7 position retained the old checkmate announcement. Clear prior move speech when an unrelated authoritative position has no completed move.
Percentage translations accumulate rounded cell widths, leaving fractional square edges misaligned with the board content width.
A native frame gate discarded delivered MutationObserver records, allowing per-frame DOM work to pass as zero.
A fresh-position raster reference reused the board model and piece nodes, allowing the same stale rendered state on both sides of a comparison.

The public performance benchmark scrubs 200 authoritative positions with default board sound enabled and emits a move sound despite being a measurement-only preview. Benchmark boards are explicitly silent.
Clearing personal marks with an ordinary primary input while the mark set was already empty emitted no empty arrow update, so the activity could not observe the clear request.
Enter or Space selection left completed personal arrows and circles on the board after drawing was disabled, while equivalent pointer selection cleared them.
After fluid width195 then fixed512, removing the fixed width at available320 briefly exposed a stale195 measurement and dismissed a still-valid promotion chooser.

A canonical g8-f6 opponent reply cleared the captured Black pawn remnant while the earlier White e4-d5 attacker was still sliding to its unchanged valid square. Keep the remnant until that arrival finishes.
Puzzle correct-move, solved and rating feedback played while the app sounds preference was muted. Honor the preference and cancel delayed seek-to-play starts.
Black a2-b1 capture promotion to bishop or knight leaves dead material but announces only the move, omitting the drawn result for silent and assistive users. Announce every canonical drawn result.
Returning from Sound settings repeats the already reached opponent opening move or a hydrated solved-puzzle cue.
Resuming an unfinished puzzle freezes completion feedback at the preliminary unrated result and omits the gain cue when its rating ledger arrives.
Equivalent completion updates repeat the rating-gain cue because the reactive trigger returns a fresh tuple for unchanged result values.
The exact release-graph contract omits the newly required Chessboard consumer conformance gate, rejecting Check and Deploy.
Native Linux font metrics place file g outside its assigned edge square at width 196 and half scale; inset both coordinate baselines inside their squares.

Merging puzzle sound scenarios with coaching changes leaves the literal step 'Alice plays a1-a5' undefined because the shared move binding requires 'the move'. Accept both existing phrasings through the same harness action.
